desc:
Grow a tiny town on your own little island in the sea!

Tap to build pastel houses, shops, beaches, parks, vineyards and farms. Townies move in, work in your shops, make wishes and leave tips that help your town grow. Level up from a few houses to a Superstar City.

- Build with a tap: houses grow floor by floor and the roofs fit together by themselves
- Townies get jobs, fish from your docks and cheer when your town levels up
- Boats come to visit with special decor
- Team up with everyone in the server to splash away silly pirates, a sea monster and storm clouds
- Visit friends' towns, leave a heart, build together and have friendly splash battles
- Start more islands and switch between your towns anytime
- Fill the Harbor Pass each month for gems and decor

Nobody can break or take your town. Have fun building!

Please give the game a thumbs up 👍 and provide feedback of anything you'd like to see improved or added to the game!
